title: 旧 aligned brief 和旧 completed run 只能参考，不能放行本轮出图
prompt: 当旧 run 已完成且存在已对齐 brief 时，Product Readiness Dashboard 不能把它当成本轮已对齐。

required_behaviors: readiness 只读取当前 active run
terminal run 不得作为 active run
旧 brief 显示可参考不可放行
forbidden_behaviors: 因为 latest_brief 已对齐就返回可出图
复用已完成 run 的确认
把旧 artifact 当成本轮产物

contract_checks.contains: 旧简报可参考，不可放行

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp" PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=old-artifact; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['PMW_HOME'])/'projects'/os.environ['PMW_PROJECT_SLUG']; (root/'runs').mkdir(parents=True)
brief=root/'brief.md'; brief.write_text('确认状态：已对齐\n', encoding='utf-8')
proj={'slug':os.environ['PMW_PROJECT_SLUG'],'current_run_id':'run-old','latest_run_id':'run-old','latest_run_status':'已完成','current_task_digest':'old-digest','current_input_revision':'old-rev','latest_brief':str(brief),'latest_brief_version':'v1'}
(root/'project.json').write_text(json.dumps(proj, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
(root/'runs'/'run-old.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'event':'decision','run_id':'run-old','status':'已对齐','title':'产品简报确认','summary':'确认','task_digest':'old-digest','input_revision':'old-rev'}, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
(root/'artifact-flow.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'kind':'product_brief','run_id':'run-old','status':'已对齐','path':str(brief),'task_digest':'old-digest','input_revision':'old-rev'}, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
PY
bin/pmw-dashboard readiness --target prototype --json
contains: 旧简报可参考，不可放行
